summary: Iteration 5 re-test — ClearVault org-scoping bug fixes VERIFIED. Full regression: 158/158 PASS (140 prior + 18 new targeted iteration-5 tests). The single regression from iteration 4 (test_recent_activity) is now FIXED. All 5 critical bugs flagged in iteration 4 are resolved: (1) upload_document now sets org_id from parent deal; (2) GET/DELETE /api/documents/{id} and /api/documents/{id}/file now use _accessible_document (joins doc→deal→org); (3) get_rollup uses _accessible_deal; (4) global_search and dashboard_stats scoped to _user_org_ids; (5) self-invite guard returns 400 'You cannot invite yourself'. Legacy backfill via _backfill_missing_doc_org_ids inside _user_org_ids verified by directly inserting a doc without org_id into Mongo and confirming the next org-scoped read auto-populates org_id from the parent deal.
critical_code_review_comments: Document.org_id is correctly persisted (verified via mongo) but DocumentOut response model does NOT surface it. Not a bug, but if any frontend code wants to display 'which org owns this doc' it would need the field added to DocumentOut. Cosmetic.

_backfill_missing_doc_org_ids is run on EVERY call to _user_org_ids — runs an extra documents.find + per-doc deals.find_one + update_one. Once all legacy docs are backfilled this is a no-op cursor (no docs match the $or filter), but the find itself still executes per request. Consider gating by a one-shot flag on user (e.g., user.docs_backfilled=true) once the find returns zero rows, to avoid the per-request scan. Performance only — correctness is fine.
_accessible_document also does an in-line backfill (server.py:175) which is correct and idempotent. Good defensive code.
Self-invite guard at server.py:1110 raises HTTPException(400, 'You cannot invite yourself'). Verified case-insensitive (Pydantic EmailStr normalises to lowercase). Solid.
models.Document.org_id was added (line 154) as Optional[str] = None. Pydantic round-trip via to_mongo/from_mongo works. Good.

rca of the issue: Iteration 4 bugs (documents not assigned org_id; GET/DELETE/file/rollup/search/stats still filtering by user_id) are all RESOLVED in iteration 5: (a) Document Pydantic model gained org_id: Optional[str] = None (models.py:154); (b) upload_document now writes org_id=deal_raw.get('org_id') (server.py:415); (c) get_document/delete_document/get_document_file all route through _accessible_document (server.py:163-176) which checks doc.org_id ∈ user's orgs, with auto-backfill via the parent deal's org_id; (d) get_rollup now uses _accessible_deal; (e) global_search filters deals and documents by {'org_id': {'$in': org_ids}}; (f) dashboard_stats counts use org_ids; (g) _user_org_ids() calls _backfill_missing_doc_org_ids() so legacy data is healed on first access by any org member; (h) create_invite raises 400 with 'You cannot invite yourself' if normalised email == inviter email. Verified all 5 fix categories with direct mongo inspection + multi-user HTTP probes.
